patterns: APPSC asks tax definitions directly: khams = state's 1/5 share of war booty; tanka (silver) and jital (copper) introduced by Iltutmish.
Other PSCs ask 'first Sultan to levy' items: ghari (Alauddin), haqq-i-sharb (Firoz), PDS/market control (Alauddin).
Technology terms recur: araghatta = water-wheel with pots (UPSC 2016, 2025); Persian wheel.
Sher Shah's rupiya and 1:64 exchange with dam appear as comparative coinage items.
App MCQs are sound and cover the same facts, plus some Mughal-city items that drift off the Sultanate-economy topic.
